question: What claim about the scope of the yoginīs is at stake in referring to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs together with their full field group?
premises: The full group of their fields is included together.
inference: The teaching concerns the complete set of earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs and their entire field group.
uncertainties: The relation between the yoginīs and sarvakṣetrakam is not syntactically explicit here.
plain_english: The full field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
